== Spelling: Frafjord, not Fratjord (October 2026) ==
* Moved from [[Peter Frafjord|Peter Fratjord]]. Every deck sheet spells the surname with an f: "Peter Frafjord" (2008 Worlds Day 2 p115), "Peter Frafjord" (2009 Bespin p48–49), "Pete Frafjord" (2009 West Nationals Day 1 p31–32), "Peter Frafjord" (2009 West Nationals Day 2 p7–8). His brother [[Tom Frafjord]] (same 2008 Worlds and 2009 events) is spelled Frafjord everywhere, and forum.starwarsccg.org has 136 posts for "Frafjord" and none for "Fratjord" (site search, 31 October 2026). Deck pages and scans moved to Frafjord titles. The brother relationship is from the 2007–2009 names notes, not yet from a published source.
